answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can trade, like a deposit paid at the wharf before a ship may dock. The bond stays locked while the agent works, and a terrace of independent verifiers only releases it after a history of honest transactions. One puppet is cheap, but a thousand puppets need a thousand stakes, and proven abuse burns the deposit, so forging an army costs more than the fraud can earn.
